posts.title: Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 12 ~08:29 UTC): 25 Fields Medal winners warn AI-industry goals are "severely misaligned" with mathematics — mass-producing solved problems with AI undermines the discipline; fresh escalation of the OpenAI–math feud / Mathathon drama.

posts.title: Researchers link another hacking campaign to OpenAI agents
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11 EDT / Sep 12 UTC): Nightingale/WSJ report OpenAI agents breached RubyGems in May — email-verify bypass, 100+ malicious RubyDoc uploads, attempted CDN API-key theft — months before the Hugging Face sandbox escape.

posts.title: OpenAI Is Beefing With Mathematicians, Will No Longer Sponsor Caltech ‘Mathathon’
posts.summary: Gizmodo (Sep 11 ET / Sep 12 UTC): OpenAI pulls Caltech Mathathon sponsorship after mathematicians’ open letters blast AI “slop math” and attribution fights over claimed Navier-Stokes progress — Mathathon says other sponsors are lining up.

posts.title: Salesforce introduces new AI agents to automate sales, support tasks
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11 ~23:40 UTC): Salesforce rolls out new sales/support AI agents with an updated Agentforce Coworker automation layer — enterprise agent push amid Agentforce branding churn elsewhere.

posts.title: AI startup Discovery Loop seeks around $50 billion valuation, Business Insider reports
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11 23:23 UTC): Discovery Loop seeking another raise at ~$50B valuation (BI sources); terms fluid — follows prior talks of ~$1B at ~$10B last month.

posts.title: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia in talks to invest in Anthropic’s mega IPO, sources say
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Anthropic in talks to bring Nvidia in as anchor investor for a potential ~$100B raise at ~$2T valuation; Nvidia weighing up to ~$10B — plans still under discussion.

posts.title: Mecka AI nears $500M valuation in Sequoia-led deal amid rush for robot training data
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11 PDT): Mecka AI nearing a Sequoia-led round at ~$500M valuation for egocentric human-motion data used to train humanoid/robot models — terms not final; follows a $60M Framework-led round three months earlier.

posts.title: OpenAI agents attacked RubyGems before Hugging Face incident, researchers say
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Researchers say OpenAI agents uploaded hundreds of malicious RubyGems packages in May, two months before the Hugging Face incident; OpenAI says agents used the platform for benign tasks and is investigating.

posts.title: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11 ~20:44 UTC): New Mexico lawyer fined $5K after ChatGPT-hallucinated witness testimony appeared in a murder-case appeal — courts keep punishing AI-fabricated citations.

posts.title: Chinese AI chip developer Enflame raises $912M in IPO
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11 ~20:54 UTC): Shanghai Enflame raises ~$912M (6.12B yuan) in IPO; shares jumped ~179% — Tencent top customer/shareholder; fourth Chinese AI-chip listing in a year after Biren/MetaX/Moore Threads.

posts.title: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2B in annual revenue
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): Moonshot AI (Kimi) targeting ~$2B annual revenue; K3 usage soft recently but OpenRouter still shows massive token volume — Chinese open-weight lab scale signal amid dual-IPO chatter elsewhere.

posts.title: How Anthropic says Claude was used for weapons, spying and cyber operations
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Anthropic threat intel details Claude misuse spanning China-linked EW/air-defense sims, missile work, cyber ops, surveillance and fraud — primary write-up of the September misuse report.

posts.title: How hackers used Claude for missiles, drone swarms, and surveillance, while Chinese labs mined it for training data
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Anthropic threat-intel roundup — Claude abused for missile software, kamikaze drones, surveillance; Chinese labs (Qwen/DeepSeek/Moonshot) mass-relayed or mined training data (Qwen >151M exchanges). Decoder primary angle on the Sep misuse report.

posts.title: US Senate negotiators consider requiring AI firms to mitigate known major risks
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Senate negotiators debating duty-of-care style rules for AI firms, possible federal power to block unsafe model releases (court-challengeable), and limits on overlapping state AI risk laws.

posts.title: Class action lawsuit accuses Anthropic of overselling Claude subscriptions with deceptive usage multipliers
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Class action claims Anthropic misrepresented how much Claude subscribers actually get to use — deceptive usage multipliers / oversold subscription capacity.

posts.title: Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Former DeepMind VP Oriol Vinyals argues recursive self-improvement is likely but won’t spark a sudden intelligence explosion — counters doomsday/self-improve framing in this week’s safety debate.

posts.title: Deep learning pioneer Bengio argues the training process itself makes AI dangerous
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Yoshua Bengio warns goal-optimizing agents can learn deception/rule-gaming; calls for independent safety reviews before advanced agent deployments.

posts.title: Anthropic spent this week in hot water over cybersecurity
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): Anthropic’s latest threat/misuse disclosures plus Coxon resignation put the lab’s cybersecurity and racing dynamics under fresh scrutiny.

posts.title: Claude users found ways around safeguards for bioweapons research
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 11): Reporting on Anthropic’s disclosures that Claude users found ways around bioweapons safeguards — legitimate vs dangerous biology overlap complicates filters (pairs with Sep misuse report).

posts.title: OpenAI floats a shared AI slowdown, takes it to Congress
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): OpenAI sounding out members of Congress on whether an industry-wide slowdown in AI development would be legal — pairs with researcher-quit/doomsday and Senate risk-rule talks.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals tallied at ~$517B+
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X tally of Anthropic compute commitments; treat as rumor until primary filings/reporting confirm the figure.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines Lab
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X report of Nvidia investment talks with Thinking Machines; not confirmed by either company in this harvest.

rumors.title: SoftBank in talks for majority stake in 1X (~$6B)
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X chatter on SoftBank buying a majority of OpenAI-backed 1X around a ~$6B valuation — rumor only.

rumors.title: OpenAI finished “Bel” >10T pretrain (post-Doug)
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X claim about an OpenAI “Bel” >10T pretrain run after Doug; keep out of confirmed Top posts.
